newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5640/5649. [CORRECTED 07:27 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5640/5649. [CORRECTED 07:27 GMT]

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5640/5649 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Monday.
The official rate for Tuesday will be 5,644.50. (Corrects offical rate for Tuesday from 5644.)
On Friday the bid/offer rates were 5637/5647, with the official dollar rate 5642 from Monday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
